hop 4 asks for items only when the plot has a primary renderer

ownership_reason: Only the gold reads the plot's datasets and renderers and creates the legend items; hop 1 creates the empty collection and returns it after the chain, and hops 2-4 hand the plot and the collection on unchanged. The gold's javadoc promises, for each dataset, the items supplied by the renderer that draws the dataset; the plot draws a dataset whose renderer slot is empty with renderer 0, and the variant gold gives that dataset no item. No one-line change above the gold can give the gold a renderer for an empty slot, since the gold fetches the renderer from the plot itself. The convention is pinned outside the gold: XYPlot.render draws with the dataset's renderer, else getRenderer(), else nothing; XYPlot.getRendererForDataset ('if not, the method returns renderer(0)') and XYPlot.getDataRange, which ranges each mapped dataset with getRendererForDataset; XYPlotTests testGetRendererForDataset (renderer 0 for the dataset whose slot 1 is empty) passes; the facade's javadoc says each legend item is generated by the plot's renderer.
